title: Consciousness
tagline: Chitta — exploring the depths of awareness

sutra.meaning:
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the Consciousness ie Chitta. The Chitta comprises of the Manas, Buddhi, Ahamkar. The mind, intellect and ego.
Then the seer abides in their true nature.

sections.insight:
The mind keeps moving. Awareness—not suppression—brings stillness. Yoga shows us how. 
When the mind settles you experience your true self—peaceful and aware.
sections.reflectionPrompt: When is my mind most restless?
sections.meditation:
3 min breathing. 
Pause and observe moments of stillness . meditate for 10 min
sections.journalPrompt: Did I observe repetitive thoughts? I should watch like I hawk which thoughts are frequent visitors.

sutra.meaning:
There are 5 types of mental modulations
They are- 1.seeking validity of knowledge, 2.perverse or wrong knowledge, 3.imagination or delusion, 4.sleep and 5.memory.

sections.insight: Some thoughts disturb some don’t. Awareness helps you choose.
